+    return table
+
+
+def _apply_table(s, table):
+    """
+    Apply every replacement of a _replace_table to s in order. A merge whose
+    left or right token never occurred in s so far cannot match, so its scan
+    is skipped: seen holds every character that was ever present (initial
+    characters plus every minted token whose replace matched), a superset of
+    the characters currently present, so skipping is exact.
+    """
+    seen = set(s)
+    for ps, c, a, b in table:
+        if a in seen and b in seen:
+            r = s.replace(ps, c)
+            if r is not s:
+                seen.add(c)
+                s = r
+    return s
